dogecoin.text: @SNLinReview Of course! I should say Ego on Weekend Update, the Philly Murder Durdur sketch, and Dogecoin absolutely tanking after the show started were the best moments of the night!!!

@AriCohn In my defense, I wanted to see how bad it was. My expectations were very low, but this #SNL is VERY bad. 

Highlights: opening sketch with the cast's moms, the Philly-specific sketch, and Michael Che grilling El*n on Dogecoin.
